description: Get current and recent tsunami warning/advisory bulletins issued by JMA via the P2PQuake network. Returns warning grade per coastal area (MajorWarning/Warning/Watch), immediate-danger flag, estimated wave height, expected first-arrival time, and the triggering earthquake details. Cancelled bulletins are included with cancelled=true for audit trails. Coverage: all Pacific, Sea of Japan, and Inland Sea coastal areas of Japan. Typical warning lifecycle: FirstReport → Update → AllClear. Use this tool for real-time tsunami monitoring in Japan. Data source: P2PQuake — community-operated JMA relay, open data, no auth required.

limit.description: Number of tsunami events to return (default 10, max 100)

order.description: Sort direction: -1 for newest-first (default), 1 for oldest-first

name: p2pquake.seismic.tsunami_warnings

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Japan Tsunami Warnings
